ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels; high local contrast gradients at boundaries of mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive stippling of high-intensity white spots across a dark background; high-density clusters of larger white spots are concentrated near the median notch and the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks; a distinct macro-scale indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread circular and sub-circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed globally; highest density observed at the distal ends of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal high-intensity linear marks visible on the right lobe near the medial notch; several horizontal linear disruptions visible on the left lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textural irregularities and high-intensity clusters at the distal tips indicative of barnacle colonization; irregular traumatic notch on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt-and-pepper' pigmentation pattern across the entire visible ventral surface.
